units.title: Deliver the first graph-adversary product vertical
units.objective: Produce one useful, traced, revision-bound causal explanation whose deterministic graph finding causes an applied append-only replan and whose immutable accepted artifact is evaluated separately by installed AES.

included: Strict project-local Pydantic contracts, deterministic direct-conflict selection, append-only revision application, replay, and loud checkpoint recovery
Exactly two Luna-medium shared-client calls with rooted receipts and no retry or fallback
Immutable JSON, directly understandable static HTML, focused both-sign tests, and a documented CLI journey
Separate installed AES immutable-baseline BLOCK-to-ALLOW consumer receipt
excluded: Legacy source mutation or wholesale copy, world modeling, truth certification, external retrieval, random strategies, SSE, deployment, alternate models, or a third critic call
Generic AES loop API design, shared graph-contract promotion, hidden fallback, in-place claim mutation, or success with a missing loop stage

outputs: Canonical graph-adversary package and documented CLI
Focused positive, negative, corruption, resume, rendering, and AES-admission evidence
Fresh Luna-medium run JSON, static HTML, exact child-call receipts, and direct-inspection record
Immutable-baseline installed AES BLOCK-to-ALLOW receipt bound to the useful result

conflict_surfaces.target: product source, tests, example input, report rendering, policy checker, evidence, package metadata, and local plan
shared llm_client codex/gpt-5.6-luna medium route and traces
installed agentic-engineering-system policy admission at the pinned revision

acceptance.criterion: Strict contracts separate proposals, committed claims, deterministic findings, digest-bound revision plans, append-only events, active projections, rendered views, and terminal evidence.
evidence_required: Positive conflict-to-revision fixture and byte-stable report
Malformed reference, reverse edge, no target, wrong finding, corrupt checkpoint, and missing-replan negatives
Replay proof that history is unchanged while active state changes
acceptance.negative_control: Free-text heuristics, prose-only advice, in-place mutation, or a non-empty graph cannot satisfy the loop contract.

acceptance.criterion: The canonical mission-drift question completes one fresh two-call Luna-medium journey and the static report directly exposes the disagreement, changed claim, evidence step-down, and remaining uncertainty.
evidence_required: Exact clean-checkout command, input/config/source digests, and terminal artifacts
Two rooted child traces with model, effort, tokens, latency, attempts, fallback, billing, and settled cost
Direct report inspection against the normative reader criteria
acceptance.negative_control: A fixture caller, one-call proposal, raw JSON alone, extra critic call, or unchanged graph cannot establish useful product output.

acceptance.criterion: Late revision, render, or admission failure retains truthful partial state and resumes only from the first incomplete stage when every prior digest matches.
evidence_required: Injected second-call or render failure with retained proposal and finding
Proof of no automatic retry, fallback, or duplicate first-stage dispatch
acceptance.negative_control: Rerunning the call graph, erasing valid work, or accepting changed checkpoint bytes invalidates recovery.

acceptance.criterion: Installed AES evaluates the immutable consumer baseline, blocks without complete coherent-loop evidence, and allows only with the exact accepted run and useful report digests.
evidence_required: Exact AES and WhyGame baseline revisions
Retained nonclaims for generic loop reuse, world-model truth, and later gates
acceptance.negative_control: Corrected worktree bytes or later unattached reports cannot rescue an invalid baseline.
